name: data-table-grouping
title: Grouped data table
author: Eduardo Retana
description: TanStack table with live column grouping that keeps the selection, collapsible group headers, a nested tree with subtotals, master-detail rows, and a pinned grand-total footer. Column order, visibility, density, filters, and page size are in the toolbar.

meta.descriptionEs: Agrupa en caliente sin perder la selección, pliega grupos, suma un árbol anidado, abre el detalle de una fila y fija el gran total. También reordena columnas, densidad, filtros y filas por página.

examples.title: Obrador, archivo y bitácora
examples.description: Pipeline agrupado por etapa, presupuesto en árbol y órdenes con subtabla de tareas.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, números, RTL, árbol, carga y error.

meta.usage:
<DataTableGrouping
  data={rows}
  columns={columns}
  getRowId={(row) => row.id}
  getRowLabel={(row) => row.name}
  aggregates={{ amount: "sum" }}
  groupCriteria={[{ id: "stage", label: "Etapa", columnId: "stage" }]}
  defaultGroupBy="stage"
  getSubRows={(row) => row.children}
  renderDetail={(row) => <Tasks row={row} />}
/>

api.name: columns
api.description: TanStack column defs (v8-compatible). Set aggregationFn or pass aggregates.

api.name: getRowId
api.description: Stable id. Selection is stored by this id, so it survives a regroup.

api.name: groupCriteria / groupBy
api.description: Group-by pills. columnId null clears grouping. Controlled with groupBy and onGroupByChange.

api.name: getSubRows
api.description: Nested tree. Parents show sum or avg of their leaves. Avg is the mean.

api.name: renderDetail
api.description: Master-detail. Expanding a row reveals this subtable under the row.

api.name: aggregates / align
api.description: Per-column total for groups, tree parents, and the pinned footer.

api.name: filters / searchText
api.description: Client-side. A parent stays visible when a descendant matches.

api.name: density / groupTone
api.type: compact | comfortable | spacious / subtle | plain | accent
api.description: Typed class maps. No private colors.

api.name: loading / error / onRetry
api.description: Loading skeletons, empty status, and an error alert with retry.

api.name: labels / className slots
api.description: Copy and className, toolbarClassName, tableClassName, groupRowClassName, rowClassName, footerClassName, detailClassName, maxBodyHeight.

docs: Clean-room reimplementation of grouped-table behavior. No Shadcn Studio source, sample data, icons, or assets were copied. The rows in the demos are fictional. This repo depends on @tanstack/react-table v9; the piece uses its v8-compatible useLegacyTable, getGroupedRowModel, and getExpandedRowModel. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar, badge, button, checkbox, dropdown-menu, input, progress, select, skeleton, or table. The piece ships no theme, cssVars, or palette colors. Chevron and meter motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. Selection keys are getRowId values, so changing the group-by column keeps the checked rows.
